newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan rescues 31 from listing Russian tanker.
newsitem.headline: Japan rescues 31 from listing Russian tanker.

text.p: Japanese authorities rescued 31 crew members of a Russian-registered oil tanker who were found adrift in life boats in the Sea of Japan on Thursday, Maritime Safety Agency officials said.
The sailors had earlier abandoned the 13,157-ton Nakhodka some 106 kilometers northeast of the Oki Islands in western Japan, about 700 km (420 miles) west of Tokyo, the agency officials said.
The fate of an additional sailor of the 32-member crew was unknown as agency vessels and helicopters searched the area, officials said.
The tanker, on a voyage from China to Russia, was taking on water and listing amid high waves and poor visibility due to fog were reported in the area of the accident, they said.
Officials have not yet sighted the abandoned ship. It was not immediately known if the tanker was loaded.
